brief: An island-town cottage lot: House at 950 Douglas Street, Vermilion, a 19th-century Lake Erie house; see the photo for its massing, porch and trim. One photo; year estimated. Older than 1970: the Lake Erie shore towns that stand in for Victory Bay's island streets (Vermilion, Sandusky, Put-in-Bay) were built 1840-1920, and Commons has almost no newer cottages there. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).

facade.notes: 950 Douglas St (Vermilion, 1880 core): an old two-storey house remuddled past recognition -- white vinyl, big replacement picture/slider windows, a gabled entry hood on a wooden deck, two satellite dishes; probably flats

why.note: cheap upkeep erases the original facade grid; the remuddled old house is a common type
